summary: Northwestern beat Ball State 45-14 with an efficient passing game and another fast start. The next work is boundary tackling and coverage before an October 17 trip to Michigan State at 11 a.m. CT on Peacock.

items.headline: Northwestern finishes nonconference play with a 45-14 win
items.tldr: The Wildcats scored on five of their first six drives against Ball State. Watch whether that opening execution holds up on the road rather than waiting for a second-half correction.

items.headline: Chiles and Wilde give the passing game a productive afternoon
items.tldr: Chiles threw for 272 yards and three touchdowns; Wilde caught eight passes for 144 yards. Run action and a clear read can keep that timing useful against Michigan State.

items.headline: The blowout still exposed coverage and tackling work
items.tldr: Inside NU’s film observations flag lost coverage assignments and missed tackles near the boundary. Those are the defensive details to watch when the opponent can turn a short play into another first down.

items.headline: Michigan State’s Patterson scores four times in an overtime loss
items.tldr: The Spartans fell 38-37 to Illinois, but Patterson scored on the ground and as a receiver. Northwestern needs an assignment for the back before the snap and a finished tackle after the catch.

items.headline: Northwestern–Michigan State is set for 11 a.m. CT on Peacock
items.tldr: The October 17 game is in East Lansing. The offense takes its next test on the road; plan for the streaming broadcast and the early kickoff.

lead.headline: Carry the passing rhythm into East Lansing.
lead.body: The offense found its receivers without asking every drive to live on the ground. Against Michigan State, keep that timing while the defense tightens the coverage handoff and the tackle at the boundary.

matchup.thesis: Keep the timing; finish the tackle
matchup.question: What should Northwestern emphasize at Michigan State?
matchup.answer: Let the run action create a clear throw without losing the protection assignment. On defense, cover the back as a receiver and finish the outside tackle before a short gain turns into an extended possession.

signals.summary: Close the play after the catch
signals.detail: Inside NU identified missed tackles and coverage gaps against Ball State. Keep the outside leverage, shed the receiver’s block and finish the tackle before chasing the turnover.
